text:
jamie: Hey team — we need to lock a time for the post-incident review for INC-2025-42 (pager storms -> degraded API throughput). Looking for a 60m slot next week. Who can host the session and who should be required attendees?

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-42 summary: pager escalations 03/04 02:12 UTC -> mitigated 03/04 03:05 UTC. Customers affected: 4 large tenants. Post-incident review template: https://redwood.internal/docs/incidents/template (auto-attached).

alex: I can host if no one else wants to. Prefer Tue/Wed afternoons UTC. I can prep the timeline and mitigation notes. :memo:

maria: thanks. I handled the initial routing — will add a short timeline snippet. Tue afternoon is ok for me but in PST so earlier in day.

sam: I should be there for the KV cache discussion. Wed 14:00-16:00 UTC works.

linda: I can facilitate from product side and ensure customer impact is captured. If we want a neutral facilitator, I can take it. Otherwise alex is fine. I'm OOO Tue morning.

jamie: ok looks like two potential slots:
- Tue 2025-03-11 15:00 UTC
- Wed 2025-03-12 14:00 UTC
I'll run a quick availability poll. Reply with the slot you prefer, or add "any" if both.

alex: I prefer Wed 14:00 UTC.

maria: Tue 15:00 for me.

sam: Wed 14:00.

linda: Wed 14:00 preferred, +1 for neutral facilitation.

ops-bot: Calendar event draft created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/INC-2025-42-pir-draft — please review. Event currently has provisional end time +60m and Zoom link.

jamie: Looks like Wed 2025-03-12 14:00 UTC is the winner. Alex will host unless Linda confirms facilitating. We also need mandatory attendees: oncall, platform lead, infra SRE, product PM, solutions eng. Anyone else?

maria: add support lead (sam) and the customer success rep for tenant A (cc @mike-cs).

alex: I can do host + timeline. Linda — do you want to facilitate? If yes, you can take the first 10m intros + run the action item review at the end.

linda: Happy to facilitate. I'll take the runbook/readout structure and keep time. I'll also draft the customer-impact slides.

jamie: Great. Action items for prep:
- alex: timeline and mitigation steps (doc in thread) -> attach before EOD Mon (owner: alex)
- maria: root-cause notes from routing changes -> attach before EOD Mon (owner: maria)
- sam: performance graphs + KV cache behavior -> attach Tue morning (owner: sam)
- linda: facilitator pre-read (agenda + slides) -> attach Tue afternoon (owner: linda)
- jamie: create PIR ticket in Jira and add attendees -> done (Jira: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/PIR-1243)

alex: noted. I'll post timeline + relevant logs here.

maria: I'll add the diff of the routing config and the small snippet that changed.

incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem notes must include customer impact table and mitigation checklist. Template link: https://redwood.internal/docs/incidents/checklist

jamie: One more ask — if anyone wants to nominate follow-up owners for long-running remediation, put them in the PIR ticket now. We'll surface them in the review.

sam: tagging ops oncall to ensure coverage during the session: @oncall (please confirm).

oncall: Confirmed, will be on audio for the review.

alex: final note: please review the query below for timeline extraction — saves manual work.
```
# logs: grep -E "ERROR|latency" /var/logs/proxy/2025-03-04.* | head -n 200
```

linda: thanks. I'll circulate the agenda + slide deck by Tue 09:00 UTC. See you all Wed 14:00 UTC. :thumbsup: 

jamie: meeting created and invites sent. If anything changes ping this thread. Thanks everyone!
